environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) running the Go binary directly. PostgreSQL 14 RDS instance in the same VPC with the application connecting as a database user 'appuser' that has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE privileges on all tables in the 'hr' schema. Security group allows inbound TCP 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No reverse proxy or load balancer in front of the application. RDS parameter group uses default settings. The DATABASE_URL connects directly to the RDS endpoint with sslmode=require.

config.db_user_privileges: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on hr.*
config.network: VPC with public subnet, SG allows 0.0.0.0/0:8080 inbound
